scope: Read-only investigation of native Mac cloned speech; no production source, installed app, cache, model or settings changed.

confirmed.finding: All four Core AI entries present, base lazy function load fails; rebuild lasts 3145.286 seconds then fails.
ANE reports cachedModelFilePath does not exist, AppleNeuralEngine code 16; MPSGraph specialized modules fail to materialize and delegate compilation fails.

Explicit app-group cache with purgeConditions rawValue 2 is active, but ANE reports updateCachedModelLocationForModelTrackedByHash toAppGroup errors. This does not establish why the lower-level file vanished.
Later build 94 launches miss base-0 cache. Current launch reports prepared after 137 seconds at 22:32:19 Moscow; no inference or audible success asserted.
Cold speech rejects successful internal load because generate captures generation before loaded increments it. Reproduced first request and after unload; second request and explicit preload work.
Prepared receipt uses app build plus OS string; prepare only constructs model, without synthesis smoke test.
Preview timeout ends caller wait after 30 seconds while synthesis continues; late result is discarded. Preparation itself has no deadline.
All CoreAIDelegates.AIModelError failures trigger cache repair; repair deletes entry before rebuilding. Retry budget is not durable across launches.
Memory contention label describes unmeasurable overlapping loads, not a resource admission gate.

limits: No end-to-end synthesis or audio playback test performed.
No real model compilation initiated by this investigation.
Direct private container file reads were denied by macOS; no access setting changed.
Why the lower-level ANE cache file disappeared remains unproven.
design: One coordinator with typed, persisted preparation and health state; fingerprint model digest, model-runtime ABI, OS build, architecture and options instead of app build.
Dedicated supervised speech worker; separate caller deadline from worker lifecycle, reject stale results, bound queues and coordinate ownership across restarts.
Prepare all assets and validate real function execution and short finite non-silent PCM before persisting validated readiness; validate supported function/capacity paths in qualification.
Persist failed/interrupted attempt and bounded retry budget; retry transient loads before considering exact-entry invalidation. Preserve healthy assets and source weights.
Show actual stage, elapsed time, actionable failure and retry; offer explicitly selected system voice if clone unavailable.
Benchmark a pinned native Swift/MLX VoxCPM2 worker as an alternative to the ANE specialization dependency, with real 16 GB Mac meeting-load and voice-compatibility acceptance.
